component.name: PadForge
component.summary: Fast native text editor with a Notepad++-style workflow

description.p: PadForge is a native Linux text editor that brings the familiar Notepad++ workflow to the Qt 6 and Scintilla stack. It offers tabbed documents, split view, syntax highlighting for dozens of languages, powerful find and replace including find-in-files, bookmarks, macros and a small plugin runtime for Lua and native plugins.
